info.title: Va de Vi API
info.description: Space-scoped API contracts for the private Va de Vi application.

get.summary: Check the API process without authentication

200.description: The API process is available.

get.summary: Get non-secret browser and feature configuration

200.description: Public environment, Firebase web, and feature configuration.

get.summary: Create or load the authenticated user's private bootstrap state

200.description: The authenticated user, active memberships, and runtime feature state.

401.description: A valid Firebase ID token is required.

patch.summary: Update the authenticated profile or active Space

200.description: The updated bootstrap state.

401.description: A valid Firebase ID token is required.

404.description: The requested active Space is not available to this user.

post.summary: Create a couple or group Space

201.description: The Space and its owner membership were created.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: True when a prior successful command was replayed.

409.description: Idempotency conflict.

patch.summary: Rename a Space, or change the language its content defaults to

200.description: The updated Space.

403.description: Only an owner may change a Space.

409.description: The Space changed before this update.

get.summary: Get one Space and its active memberships

200.description: Authorized Space detail.

post.summary: Create a seven-day single-use invitation link

201.description: The raw invitation capability is returned once through its path and is never stored.

404.description: Space not available or invitation capacity reached.

409.description: Idempotency conflict.

get.summary: Preview a valid invitation capability without authentication

200.description: Safe invitation preview.

404.description: Invitation invalid, expired, revoked, or already used.

post.summary: Accept a valid invitation idempotently

200.description: Updated session with the accepted Space active.

patch.summary: Remove a non-owner member with optimistic concurrency

200.description: Updated active membership list.

409.description: Membership version conflict.

get.summary: Export the authorized scope as versioned JSON or a selected CSV dataset

200.description: The versioned export document, or one selected CSV dataset. Media bytes require an explicit selection.

post.summary: Package explicitly selected private media into a ZIP archive

200.description: A private ZIP archive containing only the selected authorized media.

post.summary: Schedule confirmed Space deletion after a typed confirmation

202.description: The deletion job, including its recoverable grace period.

400.description: The typed confirmation did not match the Space name.

404.description: Space unavailable or the actor is not an owner.

get.summary: Read the latest Space deletion job

200.description: The latest deletion job for this Space.

404.description: No deletion job is available to this actor.

post.summary: Cancel a scheduled Space deletion during its grace period

200.description: The canceled deletion job.

404.description: No cancelable job is available to this actor.

post.summary: Leave a non-personal Space without deleting shared records

200.description: The membership is no longer active; shared records are unchanged.

400.description: A personal Space is deleted rather than left.

post.summary: Schedule account deletion after a recent sign-in

403.description: A more recent sign-in is required.

get.summary: Read the private daily usage and budget report

200.description: Aggregate counters, application budgets, and provider modes.

post.summary: Create an expiring user-review draft without performing its write

201.description: A validated draft that expires after thirty minutes.

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with an earlier draft request.

get.summary: Inspect one user-bound assistant action draft

200.description: The validated payload, status, and any confirmation result.

post.summary: Explicitly confirm an action draft exactly once

200.description: The confirmed draft and durable resource reference.

409.description: The draft is canceled, expired, or conflicts with current data.

post.summary: Cancel an action draft without writing its proposed resource

200.description: The canceled draft; no proposed domain resource is created.

409.description: A confirmed or expired draft cannot be canceled.

post.summary: Run one ephemeral, bounded Vicenç turn over authorized data

200.description: An ephemeral assistant turn. AI-disabled deployments return deterministic structured search.

400.description: The bounded turn request is invalid.

404.description: The active Space is unavailable to the caller.

get.summary: List physical bottles with inventory derived from lifecycle rows

200.description: Authorized bottles and derived inventory counts.

post.summary: Create one owned physical bottle

409.description: The idempotency key or resource ID conflicts.

patch.summary: Advance a bottle through an explicit lifecycle transition

200.description: The updated bottle.

409.description: The bottle version changed or the lifecycle transition is invalid.

post.summary: Record a purchase, its sourced price, and optional physical bottles

201.description: The purchase, derived bottles, and linked price observation.

409.description: The idempotency key or resource ID conflicts.

get.summary: List the authorized Space wishlist

200.description: Space-scoped wishlist items.

post.summary: Add one active wishlist item for a real wine

409.description: An active item or idempotency command conflicts.

patch.summary: Update or close one wishlist item with optimistic concurrency

200.description: The updated wishlist item.

409.description: The wishlist version changed.

get.summary: List timestamped sourced price observations with visible staleness

200.description: Stored price observations and explicit external-coverage warnings.

post.summary: Record a timestamped manual or cited price observation

409.description: The idempotency key or resource ID conflicts.

post.summary: Create a manually confirmed wine or an explicit identity draft

201.description: The Space-scoped wine and non-merging duplicate suggestions.

409.description: Idempotency or resource collision.

get.summary: Search the authorized Space's Wine Memory

200.description: A stable page of private wines.

patch.summary: Correct a wine's identity fields, or attach its label photograph

200.description: The corrected wine.

404.description: The wine or the Space is unavailable.

409.description: The wine changed before this update, or has been merged away.

post.summary: Create one author-owned quick or deep tasting note

201.description: The quick or deep tasting note.

409.description: Idempotency or resource collision.

post.summary: Reserve a private processed-image upload

201.description: A private upload reservation without revealing its R2 key.

409.description: Idempotency conflict.

200.description: The verified private media asset.

400.description: The bytes failed MIME, size, hash, dimension, or metadata validation.

get.summary: Stream private media after Space authorization

200.description: Private image bytes with no shared cache.

post.summary: Request optional identification while preserving manual fallback

200.description: No provider is configured; the processed photo remains private and manual entry remains available.

post.summary: Confirm or correct an identification draft and create the wine

201.description: The confirmed wine. Repeating a confirmation returns the same wine.

400.description: The draft expired or the corrected wine is invalid.

409.description: Idempotency conflict.

post.summary: Merge a confirmed duplicate into this wine after explicit confirmation

200.description: The surviving wine, moved reference counts, and the merged record id.

409.description: A wine changed or was already merged before this confirmation.

post.summary: Replay ordered offline mutations and pull authorized changes

200.description: Per-mutation outcomes and the next Space cursor.

post.summary: Create a private collaborative tasting session

409.description: Idempotency or resource conflict.

get.summary: List the authorized Space's tasting sessions

200.description: Private sessions ordered by date.

get.summary: Get one session flight without exposing other members' draft content

200.description: The ordered flight and completion state.

post.summary: Append one or more authorized wines to a session flight

200.description: The updated flight.

409.description: Idempotency, duplicate, or ordering conflict.

put.summary: Replace the flight order with the exact authorized entry set

200.description: The reordered flight.

get.summary: Compute a deterministic comparison from submitted notes only

200.description: Versioned comparison with no group score below two scored submissions.

get.summary: Read only the authenticated author's deep-tasting note

200.description: The author-owned deep-tasting note.

patch.summary: Update only the authenticated author's deep-tasting draft

200.description: The updated author-owned note.

409.description: The note version changed; current authorized data is returned in details.

post.summary: Submit the authenticated author's deep-tasting draft

200.description: The submitted note.

409.description: The note version changed.

post.summary: Store citation metadata without retaining a third-party page

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with an earlier request.

get.summary: Read one authorized source's citation metadata

200.description: Citation metadata without cached page content.

post.summary: Create a proposed wine fact with typed evidence and citations

201.description: A proposed fact; researched facts always include a citation.

409.description: The idempotency key or client resource ID conflicts.

get.summary: List authorized wine facts, citations, and visible conflicts

200.description: All current claims with alternatives preserved.

post.summary: Human-verify a preferred fact while preserving conflicting claims

200.description: The accepted preferred fact.

409.description: The fact version changed; current authorized data is returned.

post.summary: Withdraw an unwanted claim, retiring it without deleting the record

200.description: The retired fact.

409.description: The fact version changed; current authorized data is returned.

post.summary: Run bounded optional enrichment and store only proposed cited facts

201.description: Completed or explicitly degraded bounded research job.

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with an earlier request.

get.summary: Offer matching Wikidata entities for the wine's producer and region

200.description: Matching entities per subject for the reader to disambiguate.

get.summary: Read an authorized research job without provider payloads

200.description: Bounded job status, safe attempts, and created resource IDs.

404.description: The research job is unavailable to the caller.
